notes.title: Sakura Knight - release soon!
notes.notes:
[b]Sakura Knight, a new yuri fantasy style visual novel, will be coming out on Steam soon![/b]

Sakura Knight centers around a young woman called Estelle. Her mother, Cressida, was a famous knight, who once defeated the evil demon queen, Gunhild. Estelle longs to follow in her mother’s footsteps, and so sets off on a journey to prove her worth.

During her travels, Estelle meets new friends, potential lovers, and a horde of licentious slimes. Make choices to determine who Estelle ends up with, and enjoy a cute and comedic story set in a fantasy world!

notes.title: New update released
notes.notes:
We know that the new version might not be optimal yet and are looking at your feedback to improve it.

The first update with changes to adjust the game is now live and these are the changes:
- Increased monster gold gain
- Fixed Treasure chest drop bug
- Increased Treasure chest drop rate 
Probably treasure chests drop a bit too often right now, but you have to deal with increased chest drop over the weekend since our programmer is already gone till next week
- Reduced the cool down of Gold Fountain by 55 minutes 
- Increased reward value of bonus pet's that appear randomly
- Increased limit of clicks per second


We are working on bug fixes for reported issues as well as we are looking into import issues.
About the import issues: It has happened very rarely, but your old save file is not lost and when the issue is fixed, it could potentially be re-imported again. 

What is planned next:
Adding easy way to access full screen mode except for ALT + Enter
Increasing all stats from Artifacts 
Looking into click damage scaling
Fixing scaling / damage of skills
Other balancing issues that are yet being looked into.

Please be assured that your feedback is heard, we are working to improve the game in the current version.

notes.title: Patch notes for 08/11/2015
notes.notes:
- The game now has cosmetic weapons! A tab has been added to the store where you can buy them.
- Added five weapons to the new weapons tab in the store: Sword, Bow, Axe, Dual Swords and Spear.
- Made slight changes to the store UI by moving the color selection boxes and Buy button slightly to make room for a second row of color selection boxes when needed.
- Added 6 new outfits!: Knight Outfit, Kunoichi Outfit, Tribal Outfit, Demon Outfit, Wedding Dress and Chocolate Outfit.
- The demon outfit and wedding dress are available in 10 colors!
- You can no longer accidentally interact with pets while moving the scrollbar.
- The game now only auto-saves once per minute and the save is only copied to saveBackup every three minutes. This is to lessen the likelihood of file corruption.
- The game no longer deletes corrupted saves, instead renaming them to "corrupted_save" in case they are needed for technical support.
- The "Exit Game" option in the options menu has been renamed "Save & Exit".
- Made a slight clarification to the tooltip for the ally skill "Self Damage Boost".
- Fixed an issue with the tooltip for "Bonus Damage Boost" which caused it to use the wrong values.
- Fixed an issue with all ally skill tooltips that caused them to not say "Already Unlocked!" until 1 level after you've unlocked them

notes.title: Patch notes for 08/03/2015
notes.notes:
- The background image now changes depending on the area you are in.
- Slightly lowered the font size for DPS and Current Gold to prevent them from colliding.
- Adjusted the values for pet boosts, increasing their usefulness dramatically.
- Adjusted the number of spirits gained by using rebirth.
- Increased base ally strength dramatically.
- Increased the gold boost given by ally skills.
- Increased the all damage boost given by ally skills.
- Renamed "Tap Damage" pet to "Click Damage" as this was a typo.
- Adjusted the amount of idle gold rewarded when loading to better reflect how much gold would be obtained in the same amount of time playing the game without clicking.
- Improved code efficiency in some areas for better performance.
- Gift foxes now appear more reliably and more frequently.
- Chests now have a much higher drop rate.
- Gift foxes now give slightly less gold.
- Chests now give far more gold.
- Slightly lowered normal enemy health progression.
- Added a second type of gift pet that appears on the screen. This one can be clicked many times to get 50% of stage gold every time you click it until it disappears. This gift appears much less often however.
- Fixed an issue with the statistics tooltip giving the wrong boost values.
- Fixed an issue with the tooltip for Rebirth using the wrong formula for spirits gained.
- Fixed an issue that caused cost text to be white even if you can't afford it.
- Fixed an issue with the formula used to calculate idle gold gain.
- Fixed an issue with fox gifts giving half as much gold as they should.

Older patch notes can be found [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/383080/discussions/0/535152276585667266/]here[/url]
